title: Afghanistan Claims 41 Militants Killed Attempting to Cross from Pakistan
detail: Afghanistan's Defence Ministry claimed that security forces killed 41 militants who were attempting to cross into Afghan territory from Pakistan. The incident raises further border tensions between Kabul and Islamabad following a series of deadly cross-border clashes and Pakistan's September 24 airstrikes on Afghan territory. The reported death toll of 41 is notably higher than the 28 fighters killed in a similar incident reported on September 27, suggesting an escalation in cross-border incursion attempts.
confidenceReason: Reported by a single Tier 2 outlet citing Afghanistan's Defence Ministry; Pakistani side has not confirmed the incident and casualty figures in cross-border clashes are frequently contested.

media.caption: Afghanistan's Defence Ministry claims 41 militants killed attempting to cross from Pakistan.
